summary: The readers' bounds and exported lengths of the fixture builders mkexfatfixture.c and mkfatfixture.c, through exfatcheck_hosttest.c and fatcheck_hosttest.c, which compile the private copies the build gives them

argv:
set -e
d=${WORK}/builders
rm -rf "$d"
mkdir -p "$d"
cp tests/host/exfat_upcase.inc "$d/"
cp ${SRC}/tests/host/mkexfatfixture.c ${SRC}/tests/host/mkfatfixture.c "$d/"
for k in exfat fat; do
    ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -g -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host/compat -DFIXDIR='"${WORK}/fixtures"' "-DBUILDER_SOURCE=\"$d/mk${k}fixture.c\"" tests/host/${k}check_hosttest.c tests/host/compat/fixdir_host.c -o ${WORK}/${k}check_hosttest
done

rm -rf ${WORK}/fixtures
mkdir ${WORK}/fixtures
r=0
s=0
${WORK}/exfatcheck_hosttest || s=$?
[ "$s" -eq 0 ] || [ "$s" -ge 128 ] || s=1
[ "$s" -le "$r" ] || r=$s
s=0
${WORK}/fatcheck_hosttest || s=$?
[ "$s" -eq 0 ] || [ "$s" -ge 128 ] || s=1
[ "$s" -le "$r" ] || r=$s
exit $r
